in_marathi.name: Dwaipayan
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Two boats or islands
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dwaipayan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Dwaipayan is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘dwai’ meaning two and ‘payan’ meaning boats or islands. In Hindu mythology, Dwaipayan is an epithet given to sage Vyasa, the author of the Mahabharata. Vyasa is believed to have composed the epic on two islands, Badri and Shankhachudamani.
